page.notes: The scan shows a blank printed page. There is no printed text, no running head, no page number, no catchword and no signature. Visible marks are only paper stains and foxing at the upper left, a dark ink or dust spot in the centre, a few small specks, a yellowish stain at the lower left and a brown water stain at the right edge. The dark border around the page belongs to the scan and is not printed matter. No text was transcribed.
